title: Getting Started Practice 3
statement:
Module 1 (Getting Started) covers: how css works, selectors, colors and backgrounds, typography, the box model, display property. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 3: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (Colors and Backgrounds).
hints: Re-read the Colors and Backgrounds lesson example.
Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
